name: AnymeX+ β (Beta)
subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.3-beta+13

- PC player: expanding volume box, external player, audio icon, focus log
  - Volume and brightness are their own small box in the bottom bar; hover it and the box grows upwards (animated, 240 ms ease out) with a slider above each button, then slides back down when the mouse leaves.
  - External player on Windows opened the link in the browser, which just downloaded the episode. It now opens in mpv, VLC, MPC-HC or PotPlayer (first installed one; headers passed to mpv/VLC), or says to install one.
  - The Audio track button had the same speaker icon as volume: now a "voice" icon.
  - Focus bug (AnymeX loses focus to a game behind it after about a second): [focus] lines in the app log say which window took focus and from which program, to find the cause.
